items.response:
Good. I'll have fresh options for the wall behind the range and sink ready this afternoon, so you can send Nate a link before Monday.
Action: Gather a handful of backsplash options for that wall and send them with a link you can forward to Nate.

You're welcome. Tom's request for the beta merchant numbers link is still waiting for you.
Action: Set a reminder for after dinner to send Tom the beta merchant numbers link before his exec sync tomorrow morning.

I'll pull the tickets assigned to you that are marked Blocked or have an open blocking dependency, so you can see which ones to clear first before standup.
Action: Pull your blocked Linear tickets with title, status, what's blocking each and who owns the blocker, and send you the list.

I can't confirm they're all good, because the passport notes I have are old. Leo's passport was due to expire in January 2026 and yours in March 2026, both well before the Lisbon trip on 18 Dec, and I have no record that either renewal was completed. I also have nothing on Sam's passport, and Portugal usually needs at least three months of validity past your return on 30 Dec.
Action: Check your 'Renew passports' to-do and your email for renewal confirmations, then tell you each passport's status and ask you for the expiry dates I'm missing.

I'll pull every open payouts ticket from Linear and group them by workstream: reconciliation CSV export v2, payout status webhooks and the instant payout fee experiment, plus anything else that doesn't fit. For December risk, I'd look first at the bank partner API migration planned for November and at the team's thin capacity of about 2.5 engineers, then at tickets that are blocked, unassigned or overdue.
Action: Pull the open payouts tickets from Linear, group them by workstream, and flag what looks at risk for the December launch with the reason for each.

In Ontario a landlord generally can't hold a separate 'damage deposit'; only a rent deposit (applied to the last month's rent) and a refundable key deposit are allowed. If they claim damage beyond normal wear and tear, they'd need to apply to the Landlord and Tenant Board rather than keep money themselves, and minor scuffs are usually treated as wear and tear. Diego should photograph the walls at move-out and keep any written exchange with the landlord.
Action: None right now.

Ugh, same. Your passport note says it expires in March, which is this month, and I don't have a record that the renewal went through.
Action: Check your 'Renew passports' to-do and your email for a renewal confirmation and tell you where it stands.

Lower large eggs straight from the fridge into gently boiling water for 7 minutes, then move them to ice water for 5 minutes before peeling; use 6.5 minutes if you want them runnier. For ramen eggs, marinate the peeled eggs overnight in equal parts soy sauce, mirin and water so they're ready tomorrow.
Action: Set a reminder for tonight to boil and marinate the eggs.

Sorry, that's annoying. Your car insurance is with Belairdirect now (policy BD-AU-7731904), so that's where the claim goes, not Intact. Before filing, check your deductible against the repair cost, since a small scratch and dent could land under it and a claim may affect your premium.
Action: Pull the policy details from Drive, draft the claim with the Loblaws lot and date, and hold submitting until you've sent photos of the damage and told me whether to proceed.

Good timing to check. The August long weekend in 2026 is Sat 1 Aug to Mon 3 Aug, so flights would be around Fri 31 Jul to Mon 3 or Tue 4 Aug. I'd price it for one adult and for an adult plus Leo, since the child fare can differ. I don't have prices yet, so I won't quote a number.
Action: Search Toronto to Vancouver return fares for those dates and report the rough ranges in CAD for both options.

I'll set it for 30 minutes as you asked and put an agenda in the invite: the edge-case list in Aisha's doc, negative balances, reversed transfers, and next steps. Aisha prefers async, so I'll link the doc for pre-reading, and I'll avoid Wednesday afternoon around the 15:20 school pickup.
Action: Find a Monday to Wednesday slot that's free for you, Aisha and Diego, and send the invite with the agenda and doc link.

For the sync, open with something light and quick, like each person sharing one small win and one thing they're looking forward to, or a one-word weather check on their week. For the evening at home, keep it low effort: a simple dinner and a shared movie or game, with nothing scheduled.
Action: Hold the open evening on your calendar for the end of next week so nothing gets booked into it, assuming Friday unless you say otherwise.

You earned it. Nothing in what I've handled today needs you tonight; the only dated item is the Fintech Meetup talk title, headshot and bio, due 18 Sep.
Action: Set a reminder for Monday morning to send the talk title, headshot and bio to Farah at the meetup.

You're welcome. My pick is Brijwasi Sweets: best freshness reviews at 4.6 from 2,300 ratings, Rs 1,450 plus Rs 120 delivery, and same day if ordered before 14:00 IST. I still need your mom's delivery address before I can place it.
Action: Hold the order until you send the address, then order from Brijwasi.

I'll check Tom's calendar for the 24th, but I can only see free and busy times if he's shared his calendar with you, so I'll tell you if the detail isn't visible. I'm assuming the 24th of this month.
Action: Pull Tom Becker's calendar for the 24th, list his free windows, and flag what I couldn't see.

I don't have your packing method saved, so I'm building the trip-home list from what went wrong this time: Leo's swim shirt and his stuffie at the top, and a check that both are in the bag before you leave. I'm also keeping the first-day items you'd need if your bags are delayed in a carry-on.
Action: Create a 'Trip home packing' checklist in Notes with those items first, and set a reminder for the evening before you fly.

Spy series night is blocked: Sunday 21 Jun, 20:30 to 22:00, with Sam. For your mom's mithai, I'll look for well-reviewed Mumbai shops that deliver, get delivery quotes, and come back with a recommendation, but I need her address in Mumbai first.
Action: Block the Sunday evening, check for conflicts, and start the search and quotes for the mithai.

I don't have your Halloween evening plan saved, so here's what still needs sorting: the costume (what he's going as sets the parts list), who's walking with him and what time you leave, safety bits like reflective tape and a flashlight, and any allergy rules for treats. Send me the costume idea and I'll turn the cardboard box into a build plan.
Action: Add a Halloween checklist to your to-do with 'costume parts' due this weekend.

Here's a reply for your mom: 'Beta, from this week our call is Saturdays at 8:30 am Toronto time, which is 6:00 pm for you, because Leo's soccer now takes Sunday mornings.' I'll tell Kabir the same new time. My note has Leo's soccer on Saturdays, but you said it's Sunday now, so I'm treating Saturday 8:30 as clear.
Action: Reply to Mummy, change the recurring call to Saturdays 8:30 am Toronto / 6:00 pm IST and end the Sunday series, and message Kabir the new time.

I'll sort your copy of the 1:1 with Tom so it shows Wednesdays at 11:30 from January 2026 instead of Thursdays, and the 17:15 reminder for the Shoppers pickup at Queen & Carlaw is set.
Action: Accept Tom's new Wednesday 11:30 series, remove your old Thursday copy, confirm the first date from his invite, and set the 17:15 reminder.

Try: 'If a payout fails because of a bank-side error, the system shall automatically retry the payout without merchant action.'
Action: None needed.

I'll check your library holds: what's ready for pickup and what's due this week, and I'll renew what's renewable. Tom's request for the beta merchant numbers link is still open for after dinner.
Action: Check your Toronto Public Library holds and due dates, renew eligible items, and send you the pickup list.

I'll write the note for Tanvi: the 2026 guideline is 2.1% for units first occupied before 15 Nov 2018, anything above it needs LTB approval, and the landlord must give 90 days' notice on Form N1, no more than once every 12 months. If she gets a 9% notice with no LTB application, she can pay the guideline amount and reply in writing, and I'll include the Ontario guideline, LTB and Form N1 links.
Action: Create the note and a shareable copy, then give you the share link.

Sorry about Leo's tooth. For a chip, a same-week appointment usually means calling the office rather than booking online, and if he has pain, bleeding or a sensitive tooth, ask for the earliest injury slot. I don't have Dr. Lin's office address saved, so I can't give you the travel time yet.
Action: Look up Dr. Lin's office, ask for the earliest after-school injury slot this week, and send you the confirmed time and the travel time from home.

Your street has Thursday collection, every other Thursday since it resumed on 9 Apr, and holiday weeks shift it by a day. Yard waste goes out in paper yard waste bags or labelled rigid containers, no plastic, with branches under 7.5 cm, bundled, and no longer than 1.2 m or heavier than 20 kg. Paper bags are $11.98 for a 10-pack at the Home Depot on Leslie St.
Action: Add the next two yard-waste pickups to your calendar with a Wednesday evening reminder to set out the bags, and note the paper bags for your shopping list.

Here's a note for #payouts-team: 'I'm heads down until 3:00 pm for focus time. I'll catch up on threads after, so ping me directly if it's urgent.'
Action: Set your Slack status to heads down until 3 and post that note in #payouts-team.

Night.
Action: None.

I don't have this year's opening date saved, so I'll check rather than guess.
Action: Look up the Leslieville Farmers Market's opening date for this year and add it to the calendar.

Your call with your mother Anjali is now a recurring slot every Sunday at 9:00 am Toronto time, 6:30 pm in Mumbai, kept clear and shown as busy; note it'll be 7:30 pm in Mumbai once Toronto is on standard time. For Spanish, I'd do short role-play sessions between lessons with Carlos, speaking in Spanish with quick corrections, and log your recurring mistakes to take to him.
Action: Create the recurring Sunday 9:00 am block and set up a 'Spanish practice' note for the role-play sessions and error log.

Added 'get passport photos for Leo' to your to-do.
Action: Add it to the to-do list with no due date.

A heat warning means Environment Canada expects two or more days of high heat and humidity, roughly daytime highs of 31 C or more with overnight lows of 20 C or more, or a humidex of 40 or more. An extended heat warning in Toronto means those conditions are forecast to last longer, about three days or more, which triggers extra measures like more cooling centres and longer hours.
Action: None needed.

That sounds like the right way to spend it. I'll leave the career day talk for later.
Action: None.

I'll give the kitchen crew a heads up that the electrician can come Monday and ask which time window works for them, so I can line the two up. If nobody's home Monday while you're away, someone needs to let them in.
Action: Message the kitchen crew about the Monday electrician and ask for their available times, then confirm a time with the electrician and check who can be home.

Both are set: sending Tom your comments on the strategy memo is due Friday, and Leo's library books are waiting for pickup at Pape on Saturday morning.
Action: Set a Friday morning reminder for the memo comments, and a Saturday morning reminder for the books after checking the Pape/Danforth branch opening time.

I'll go by each PDF's scan date from its metadata, falling back to the file's last-modified date, and rename them as YYYY-MM-DD with a number added if several share a day.
Action: Rename the Scan_*.pdf files in Downloads that way and keep a log of the old and new names so it can be undone.

I'll check the beta docs for links to the old pricing page. I don't have its old URL, so I'll start with links containing the pricing path and tell you what I'd treat as the old address.
Action: Search your Notion and Drive docs for links to the old pricing page, test each one, and list the broken ones by doc.

I'd focus this week on the subjunctive and the noun-gender exceptions you keep missing (el problema, el mapa, el tema, la mano), plus whatever homework Carlos emailed, with some DELE B2 practice if time allows. Class is Thursday at 19:30.
Action: Block study time before the lesson, two 30-minute sessions earlier in the week and a 20-minute warm-up on Thursday before 19:30, around your existing commitments.

Glad you landed. I'll pull up the flight search from before you booked and tell you the fare in CAD, and I'll find the Lafourcade piece I did for you.
Action: Find the earlier flight search and send Kabir the fare, and find the Lafourcade song item and send it to Mei.

I don't have yesterday's route in front of me. Toronto to Ottawa usually takes around 4.5 hours before stops, so a Big Apple break stretches it.
Action: Pull up the route and estimate I gave you yesterday, and compare it with your actual drive time.

From what I can see here: I drafted your out-of-office for Fri 22 May (back Mon 25 May, Aisha covering payouts questions), which you haven't sent, and I checked the beta retro: 9 accepted, Olivia tentative, Jonah hasn't replied, and 14 stickies are on the Miro board with webhook retries the top theme.
Action: None.

I can't confirm the Withrow rink yet; outdoor rinks depend on the temperature and the day's maintenance, so I'll check the status and Saturday's afternoon forecast. Tomorrow works for the insurance letter photo.
Action: Check the City's status for the Withrow Park rink and Saturday afternoon's forecast, and tell you if it's open.

Booking a 25-minute call with Olivia and Aisha on the 9th at 3:30 pm, with your agenda in the invite: where certification stands, what sales can and can't say, and the next checkpoint.
Action: Check your calendar and theirs for the 9th at 15:30, then send the invite for 15:30-15:55 with that agenda.

Regular international letter mail from Toronto to Mumbai typically takes about two to three weeks, and it can run longer in busy periods, so I'd allow a margin. Canada Post's current estimate is the one to trust.
Action: Check Canada Post's posted estimate for letter mail to Mumbai and tell you the latest date to mail it for your target arrival.

Okay, the charcoal bag order stays on hold until you've talked to Sam. Separately, East End Plumbing is confirmed for Mon 29 Jun, 09:00 to 12:00, and they need the inside shut-off valve accessible.
Action: Hold the order, and set a reminder for Sunday evening to clear access to the shut-off valve.

Wanting toast in your own kitchen after this long is completely fair. For the floors, stop sweeping, since it pushes the fine dust into the air and back down. Use a vacuum with a HEPA filter and a soft brush attachment first, then a barely damp microfibre mop, then a dry cloth, and skip wet mopping or scrubbing pads on hardwood.
Action: Write a short step-by-step dust-control routine you can follow in the evenings and save it to Notes.
